gameLocalization.note: Names follow paired Canto X part 1 records. The ellipsis variant of the area skill is resolved by ID 148204; One-leg follows enemy 1483. Preservation Potency and Count remain distinct. Route A stats, conditional Unbreakable conversion, per-Coin volley targeting, and the consecutive battle are retained.

stageName.text: Sisyphus Department Store A, 4F: Shoes Floor, First Battle

lead.text: Break the Shield and attack before Preservation Potency builds up. Win against the powerful Unfocused Volley for halved damage and Stagger prevention. Defeating Four-legs leads directly into One-leg.

listLead.text: Break the Shield before Preservation Potency builds up. Win against Unfocused Volley with a strong skill to halve damage and prevent Stagger. Another enemy follows immediately after victory.

statNote.text: Route A: Lv. 23 and 814 HP. Defense Level 25 excludes additional Fabric modifiers. Separate from Route B's Lv. 48 version starting with Preservation 3/15 and a 1,000 Shield. Covers normal Route A “Nail” progression. In this dungeon, Customer Level replaces outside Identity levels. Uptie below III is raised to III, but E.G.O Threadspin is unchanged. Form a team of up to 12 including each floor's three required Sinners. SP and E.G.O resources carry over after battles. The 4F required Sinners are Meursault, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu.

skillNote.text: Coins that change at 3 or more Preservation Potency are conditional and are not shown as permanently Unbreakable. Unfocused Volley selects a target for each Coin; its three Coins do not hit everyone simultaneously.

priorities.0.text: Break the Shield instead of leaving it up, and damage HP before Preservation Potency reaches 3.

priorities.1.text: Win against the powerful Unfocused Volley to halve damage and prevent Stagger.

priorities.2.text: Save HP and E.G.O resources for the consecutive One-leg battle.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: The same regular skills keep getting stronger

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: At 8 or more Preservation Count, regular skills gain Coin Power. Tremor on the target also raises Final Power. Check current Preservation and clash predictions rather than base maximum Power alone.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: An added area skill prevents recovery

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: At Turn Start with 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count, uses Unfocused Volley in an extra slot. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from the skill, so prioritize a strong E.G.O against it.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The next enemy wins after Four-legs falls

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: One-leg follows Four-legs immediately. Losing the second battle restarts from Four-legs. Avoid wasting E.G.O at the end; save healing and resources for major skills.

phases.0.title.text: Finish shopping and prepare for consecutive battles

phases.0.steps.0.text: Meursault, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu are required. Bring your main attackers and HP recovery, using carried-over SP and E.G.O resources.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Aim for Customer Lv. 25 through shopping. You do not need to raise outside Identity levels. An official RENTAL Identity is available for Meursault too.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Check Blunt resistance and E.G.O for strong clashes. Threadspin is not raised, so choose according to required effects and resource costs.

phases.0.steps.3.text: Entering the Shoes Floor from the corridor starts combat. One-leg follows Four-legs, so prepare healing and high-Power skills for both battles.

phases.1.title.text: Break the Shield and avoid a prolonged fight

phases.1.steps.0.text: Starts with Preservation 1 Potency / 0 Count and 3 Fabric. Ending a turn with a Shield remaining increases next-turn Preservation Count and Defense Level.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Taking hits while Shielded also adds Preservation Count. Do not leave the Shield intact through small attacks; concentrate damage to reach HP.

phases.1.steps.2.text: Use Sloth ×1.5 and Lust ×1.25. All physical resistances are ×1.2, so there is no need to focus on one physical type.

phases.2.timing.text: Please, cut them off! I beg you!

phases.2.title.text: Assign a strong clasher regardless of Speed

phases.2.steps.0.text: Can be clashed with regardless of Speed. At 10 or more Preservation Count, consumes it for +1 Base Power and +1 Coin Power, so do not judge only from the base maximum of 14.

phases.2.steps.1.text: At 3 or more Preservation Potency, all Coins become Unbreakable. Heal the clasher beforehand to prepare for Tremor Bursts remaining after a clash win.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Stagger does not skip the enemy's action pattern. Recheck the skills it will use after recovery.

phases.3.timing.text: 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count

phases.3.title.text: Win against Unfocused Volley and limit damage before the next battle

phases.3.steps.0.text: The extra-slot “Clippety-clop, what an awful sound...” has three Unbreakable Coins. On use, inflicts 3 Tremor and 3 Count on all targets.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from this skill's damage and effects. It does not evade everything, but controls damage better than leaving it unopposed.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Unfocused Volley's first Coin hits the main target; later Coins choose a random target among those attacked. Heal secondary targets too.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Resources and SP carry into the One-leg battle. Once victory is assured, do not add unnecessary powerful E.G.O; save them for the next major attack.

mechanics.0.effect.text: The dungeon level raised by spending eyeballs in department-store shops. Determines Identity levels inside the dungeon.

mechanics.0.response.text: If clashes are too weak, check unvisited shops and vending machines instead of farming outside EXP.

mechanics.1.effect.text: A special Charge affected by effects that change Charge Potency and Count. The usual Count cap is 20; lose 1 Count at Turn End. Enemy passives increase Preservation Potency and other effects through cumulative Count consumption.

mechanics.1.response.text: Check Potency and Count separately. Spending Count may still advance buffs based on cumulative consumption.

mechanics.2.effect.text: At −20 SP or lower, maximum Speed −1 and Defense Level +1; at −45 or lower, maximum Speed −5 and Defense Level +3. Clash wins and losses also change SP.

mechanics.2.response.text: Lowering enemy SP is useful, but reduced Speed does not finish the fight. Check remaining HP and Shields.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Maximum 15. Per 5 stacks, maximum Speed −1 and Offense/Defense Levels +1. Lose 1 at Turn End. Some passives also grant Shields according to Fabric stacks.

mechanics.3.response.text: Check Fabric's level changes and Shields; avoid repeated small attacks that only chip at the Shield.

mechanics.4.effect.text: Each Coin chooses one random attack target. The first always hits the main target; each Coin's damage and on-hit effects apply only to its chosen target.

mechanics.4.response.text: Check secondary targets' HP too. Distinguish this from the on-use Tremor applied to every target.

warnings.0.text: Preservation Potency and Count are separate. The regular skill's threshold of 8 uses Count; the Unbreakable threshold of 3 uses Potency.

warnings.1.text: Route A starts at Preservation 1/0. Do not mix it with Route B's enhanced opening state.

warnings.2.text: Winning against the area skill leaves on-use effects and Unbreakable attacks. Do not skip HP recovery.

warnings.3.text: Losing to One-leg restarts from Four-legs. Do not spend all resources on winning only the first battle.

preparation.0.text: Meursault, Don Quixote, and Hong Lu are required. Bring your main attackers and HP recovery, using carried-over SP and E.G.O resources.

preparation.1.text: Aim for Customer Lv. 25 through shopping. You do not need to raise outside Identity levels. An official RENTAL Identity is available for Meursault too.

preparation.2.text: Check Blunt resistance and E.G.O for strong clashes. Threadspin is not raised, so choose according to required effects and resource costs.

roles.0.reason.text: Break the Shield and progress before Preservation buffs build up.

roles.1.name.text: High-Power clash against the extra area skill

roles.1.reason.text: Trigger the clash-win damage reduction and Stagger prevention.

roles.2.name.text: Healing and resources for consecutive battles

roles.2.reason.text: Maintain fighting strength through the following One-leg battle.

units.0.notes.0.text: On entry, gain 1 Preservation Potency and 0 Count.

units.0.notes.1.text: Normal Route A progression, separate from Route B's enhanced version.

skills.0.effects.1.text: - Final Power +1 per 4 Tremor on the target (max 3)

skills.0.effects.2.text: - At 8 or more Preservation Count, Coin Power +1

skills.0.effects.3.text: [On Use] If Preservation Count is below 15, gain 2 Preservation Count

skills.0.response.text: At 8 or more Preservation Count, Coin Power +1. Tremor on the target also strengthens it; do not ignore it because base Power is low.

skills.1.effects.1.text: - Final Power +1 per 4 Tremor on the target (max 3)

skills.1.effects.2.text: - At 8 or more Preservation Count, Coin Power +1

skills.1.effects.5.text: - At 3 or more Preservation, convert the last Coin to an Unbreakable Coin

skills.1.effects.6.text: Ⅰ [On Hit] Inflict 3 Tremor and increase Tremor Count by 2

skills.1.effects.9.text: [On Hit] At 15 or more Preservation Count, consume 3 to trigger Tremor Burst; reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.1.response.text: At 3 or more Preservation Potency, the last Coin becomes Unbreakable. Stop it with a regular skill to prevent Count gains on hit.

skills.2.name.text: Please, cut them off! I beg you!

skills.2.effects.0.text: Can clash with this skill regardless of Speed

skills.2.effects.2.text: - At 10 or more Preservation Count, consume 10 for +1 Base Power and +1 Coin Power

skills.2.effects.3.text: - With fewer than 10 Preservation Count, gain 5 Count

skills.2.effects.4.text: - At 3 or more Preservation, convert every Coin of this skill to an Unbreakable Coin

skills.2.effects.6.text: Ⅱ [On Hit] Increase Tremor Count by 3

skills.2.effects.7.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Trigger Tremor Burst. Reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.2.effects.8.text: [On Hit] If this skill consumed Preservation Count, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.2.response.text: Can be clashed with regardless of Speed. Gains strength at 10 or more Count and fully Unbreakable Coins at 3 or more Potency. Maintain the clasher's HP too.

skills.3.effects.2.text: Whenever this skill hits, trigger Tremor Burst and reduce the target's Tremor Count by 1

skills.3.effects.5.text: - Inflict 3 Tremor and 3 Tremor Count on all targets

skills.3.effects.6.text: - At 10 or more Preservation Count, consume 10 for +2 Base Power and +2 Coin Power

skills.3.effects.9.text: - This skill's damage and effects cannot Stagger its targets

skills.3.response.text: An Unfocused Volley with three Unbreakable Coins. Winning halves damage and prevents Stagger from the skill. Assign a strong skill and heal secondary targets too.

passives.0.effect.text:
At Stage Start, gain 3 Le Noir: Worsted.
At Turn Start, gain a Shield equal to (Le Noir: Worsted stacks)% of max HP, unless Staggered.

Le Noir fabric shapes the customer's figure with an armor-like, sturdy silhouette that holds its form.

passives.0.condition.text: At battle start and Turn Start

passives.0.response.text: Starts with 3 Fabric, granting a Shield equal to its stacks as a percentage of max HP while not Staggered. Break the Shield and damage HP instead of leaving it up.

passives.1.effect.text:
For cumulative Preservation Count consumed during battle:
- Gain 1 Le Noir: Worsted per 3 consumed.
- Gain 1 Preservation per 10 consumed.

At 3 or more Preservation Potency, maximum Preservation Count +5.

Condense, gather power, and hold it in place. Keeping something unchanged can require more force than changing it.

passives.1.response.text: Every 10 Count consumed adds Potency. Check buff progression even immediately after Count is spent.

passives.2.effect.text:
At Turn Start with 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count, use a powerful skill.

Power gathered in one place to hold something still will eventually burst out.

passives.2.condition.text: At Turn Start: 3 Preservation Potency and at least 10 Count

passives.2.response.text: Save high Clash Power for the extra-slot area skill.

passives.3.effect.text:
When hit by a Sinner while Shielded, gain 1 Preservation Count.
- At 3/5 Preservation Potency, gain 2/3 Count instead.

If a Shield remains at Turn End, gain 1 Preservation Count and 1 Defense Level Up next turn per Preservation Potency (max 3 each).

Convert outside forces that would cause change into a force for self-preservation.

A world where, however much one wishes to remain unchanged and still, something must always change.

passives.3.condition.text: Taking hits while Shielded; Turn End

passives.3.response.text: A remaining Shield strengthens Count and defense. Do not prolong the fight using only small attacks.
